name: Ranger's Bramble
text:
You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of Entangling Flora. A creature that critically fails the save takes max(0,@item.level -1)d4 bleed damage in addition to being Immobilized. Escaping your bramble doesn't end the bleed damage.

---

Heightened (+1) The bleed damage on a critical failure increases by 1d4.
